description: Acknowledgment for USER moves with cp_loss < 30. Originally cp_loss==0 only (Mohit 2026-05-19); extended 2026-05-28 (Parth yellow-bucket fb_deed013c3f35 / fb_b250249f7724 / fb_dc63587ede08 / fb_fa464cae3b84) to cover cp_loss 1-29 near-best moves that previously fell in a silent gap. Specific variants (develop / capture / central_break / bishop_pair_trade) fire on any near-best move where the signal applies; the 'strongest move here' default only renders on exact-best (cp_loss == 0) to avoid overclaiming on suboptimal moves. Without an unambiguous why-signal AND with cp_loss > 0, the rule renders silent — honest silence > invented reason.

fact_glossary.good_move_reason: capture | central_break | bishop_pair_trade | develop | (unset). Set by inject_good_move_reason_facts when the why is deterministically safe.
fact_glossary.good_move_captured_square: square of the capture, when good_move_reason == capture
fact_glossary.good_move_trade_target_color: 'light' | 'dark' — square colour of the enemy bishop the trade offer targets. Set with bishop_pair_trade.

variants.central_break: {played_san} — fights for the center. Control the center and your pieces get the best squares.
variants.bishop_pair_trade: {played_san} — offers to trade {good_move_trade_target_color}-square bishops. Opponent has the bishop pair; trading one removes that advantage.
variants.develop: {played_san} — develops a piece. Get every piece into the game before you attack.
